import Toybox.Lang;
import Toybox.System;
import Toybox.Time;
import Toybox.Time.Gregorian;

// UTC arithmetic and local watch presentation have separate sources. Do not apply
// a time-zone offset to Time.now(), which is already an absolute UTC moment.
class WatchClock {
    function initialize() {}

    function utcSeconds() as Number {
        return Time.now().value();
    }

    function localTimeText() as String {
        var clock = System.getClockTime();
        return formatLocal(clock.hour, clock.min);
    }

    // Gregorian.info resolves the current Moment in the watch's local time.
    // Numeric short format avoids SDK locale text and preserves one layout.
    function localCalendar() as Array<Number> {
        var local = Gregorian.info(Time.now(), Time.FORMAT_SHORT);
        return [local.day_of_week as Number, local.day, local.month as Number];
    }

    function formatLocal(hour as Number, minute as Number) as String {
        return hour.format("%02d") + ":" + minute.format("%02d");
    }
}
